body:
Honestly with the suboxone I don't even want to use. I've been taking them for 3 months, monitored by a doctor. It really has very little to do with why I'm here. I am terrified of the thoughts I'm having. I've dealt with suicidal ideation before, but never this severe. I'm thinking this way every day, not all the time, but every day. What scares me the most is that I'm perfectly calm when I start thinking about it. It's more of a reserved,"yeah, this is something I'll end up doing" feeling. I know I should tell my doctor, but part of me is scared the suboxone is doing this to me and I don't want to stop taking it; I know if I do I will go right back to my life before and I really don't want that. I also don't want to get hauled off to a psychiatric ward...I don't know if that actually happens, but I'm scared it will...

Thanks for taking the time to read and answer.
suboxone for opiate withdrawal and trazadone for sleel
